nodes.label: UI conventions
nodes.rationale: Colours are CSS variables with light and dark themes; layout must work at 390px wide and on desktop with no horizontal scroll.

nodes.label: Content licensing constraints
nodes.rationale: Vocabulary and kanji data is CC BY-SA 4.0 via MIT-licensed converters. Code from AGPL/GPL reference repos and data from anki-jlpt-decks (CC BY-NC) must not be used.

nodes.label: Derived XP and streaks
nodes.rationale: Total XP and streaks are derived from days and never stored separately, to avoid divergent values.

nodes.label: Environment variables and secrets policy
nodes.rationale: Secrets are never committed; Firebase web config goes into Vercel env vars or .env.local.

nodes.label: Item and lesson ID scheme
nodes.rationale: Changing item ids or lesson sizes breaks saved progress; avoid, or add a migration.

nodes.label: Local-first progress store
nodes.rationale: Progress changes go through useProgress actions, are marked pending and flushed by sync.ts so the app works offline and signed out. Day counters use increment(); cards merge by up timestamp.

nodes.label: Playwright sandbox browser path
nodes.rationale: Playwright's own browser cannot be downloaded in the Claude Code cloud sandbox, so e2e commands are prefixed with PW_CHROMIUM_PATH=/opt/pw-browsers/chromium.

nodes.label: Polyglot Japanese learning app
nodes.rationale: Personal Duolingo-style Japanese learning PWA; runs on desktop and installs to iPhone home screen; deployed on Vercel with optional Firebase sync.

nodes.label: User decisions
nodes.rationale: English meanings, Google sign-in, no AI features in v1, lesson content bundled with app and Firestore storing only progress. Kept unless the user changes them.

nodes.label: Same-site auth domain proxy
nodes.rationale: Safari and the iPhone home-screen app block the cross-site storage that firebaseapp.com sign-in relies on, so the auth domain is the Vercel domain and next.config.ts proxies /__/auth/* to Firebase.

nodes.label: Guest mode baseline
nodes.rationale: The app works without any setup because progress is saved per device; sign-in and sync are optional extras.

nodes.label: Optional Google sign-in and Firestore sync
nodes.norm_label: optional google sign-in and firestore sync

nodes.label: Inspiration projects
nodes.rationale: UI and feature ideas were inspired by kana-dojo, read-frog, mural, anki-jlpt-decks and LLPlayer; no code from them is used.

nodes.label: Project changelog
nodes.rationale: Every change adds a changelog entry in the same commit, keeping an auditable history of changes.

nodes.label: GitHub main workflow
nodes.rationale: main is the production branch and Vercel deploys it automatically, so changes go through feature branches, verification, changelog and PR before merge.
